task.title: Installing the plugin
task.shortdesc: Install the plugin into a DITA Open Toolkit with a single command; there are no other dependencies.

prereq.p: You need the version 4.4.1 or later, running on Java 17 or later. No Node.js, no package managers, and no network access at build time.

step.cmd: Install the plugin from the latest release.
Confirm the govuk format is available.

result.p: The toolkit can now build any DITA map with --format=govuk. To upgrade later, run the same install command with the newer release URL — the toolkit replaces the installed version.
